  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Streaming players, smart speakers, displays and a camera do not address the computer connectivity needs reflected in my purchases.",
    "The memory cards have no clear use for me without a storage need and a compatible device.",
    "Buying a headset once does not mean I currently need a portable speaker or replacement earbuds."

  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The suggestions treat an interest in practical computer accessories as an interest in electronics generally.",
    "The list favors items with higher purchase popularity than my past accessories, but that does not give me a reason to need them."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My adapters, expansion card and cable serve specific connection needs; the connection type and device compatibility matter more than simply being electronic.",
    "My purchases are spread over years and address distinct needs, so an older purchase is a weak reason to suggest a replacement or another loosely related device.",
    "I rarely choose anything without a concrete use for it, and none of these suggestions gives me that reason now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations interpret my occasional purchases of practical accessories as broad demand for popular electronics, missing the specific problems those purchases solve."
}
